question.text: PFRDA (Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority) regulates:

answer.text: National Pension System (NPS) and pension schemes

explanation.text: The Logic: PFRDA regulates the National Pension System (NPS) and any other pension scheme under its ambit. It also registers fund managers, custodians, central record keeping agencies, and trustee banks for the pension sector. NPS itself offers different fund managers and investment choices to subscribers. The Trap: Life insurance is under IRDAI, mutual funds under SEBI, and bank deposits under RBI. Each product line has its own regulator, and PFRDA's mandate is limited to the pension space. Note: Source basis is p.93 (PFRDA regulatory role) and p.103 (NPS investment choices and fund managers) of the NISM-Series-X-A Investment Adviser (Level 1) workbook (June 2025).
